supporting_observations.claim: The account ext.rwong was created on DC-NWD-01 at 13:44:07 UTC, within the review window.

The account creation was attributed to nora.blake. A preceding network logon on DC-NWD-01 identifies nora.blake connecting from WS-NBLAKE-01, and its logon ID matches the subject logon ID on the creation event.
Seconds after creation, nora.blake added ext.rwong to the Freelancers group using the same subject logon ID as the creation event.
The ext.<name> account name and Freelancers group addition match the organization's stated help-desk practice for temporary accounts; the evidence is consistent with expected account provisioning.

known_telemetry_limitations: The available records show the account creation and Freelancers group addition, but do not provide a complete view of the account's group memberships or permissions.
The provided records do not show whether ext.rwong was subsequently used, or whether the account request had separate approval.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish who requested the account or whether the request was formally approved.
The evidence does not establish that ext.rwong had no other group memberships or privileges beyond the recorded Freelancers addition.
The evidence does not establish whether the new account was used after creation.
unrelated_findings: Cisco AnyConnect vpnui.exe was launched under nora.blake on WS-NBLAKE-01, and a Cisco-signed library was loaded. These records establish a client launch, not a VPN connection; given the inventory's statement that the organization has no VPN, review separately if warranted. This does not determine the account-creation alert. (T048-00009, T048-00010, T048-00011)
